comparison.objective: Instill exactly one eye drop into a drawn-down lower-lid pocket and return the bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Light-contact lid displacement combined with precise nozzle aiming and tightly controlled squeeze force/duration.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one modeled drop lands in the pocket, tip never contacts the face, force limits are respected, lid closes, and bottle is released on the tray.
comparison.reason: Its central ability is delicate bimanual dosing near a compliant anatomical target; the candidate tests mechanical adjustment and impact response.
